name: stack-guard
description: One-prompt security check and safe fix for everything you build and run with Claude Code.

secret_guard.title: Secret guard
secret_guard.description: Keeps secret files and keys out of the chat while stack-guard is in use (all three secret-guard hooks).

reply_check.title: Final-reply check
reply_check.description: After each reply, checks it for secret shapes. To do that it reads the session's history on this computer; nothing leaves the computer. Turning it off keeps the other two secret-guard hooks.

update_check.title: Update check
update_check.description: Once a day asks GitHub for stack-guard's version number (never code) at session start, at the start of /stack-guard and in the daily watch.
